description: Forwarding policy entry of the transit router. The forwarding policy entry matches source and destination address segments and forwards matching traffic to the specified transit router route table.

CreationTime.description: Creation time of the forwarding policy entry.

Description.description: Description of the forwarding policy entry. Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。). Length must be between 0 and 255 characters.

DestinationCidrBlock.description: Destination address segment of the forwarding policy entry. Supports IPv4 and IPv6 subnets. If this parameter is empty, it matches all destination addresses.

Priority.description: Priority of the forwarding policy entry. Value range: 1–10000. Priorities cannot be duplicated within the same forwarding policy.

SourceCidrBlock.description: Source address segment of the forwarding policy entry. Supports IPv4 and IPv6 subnets.

Status.description: Status of the forwarding policy entry. Available: available. Creating: creating. Pending: configuring. Deleting: deleting. Conflicted: not effective.

TransitRouterForwardPolicyEntryId.description: ID of the forwarding policy entry.

TransitRouterForwardPolicyTableId.description: ID of the forwarding policy to which the entry belongs.

TransitRouterRouteTableId.description: ID of the transit router route table to which traffic matching this forwarding policy entry is forwarded.

UpdateTime.description: Last operation time of the forwarding policy entry.
